trajectory.judgment_scope: memory demand and customer inventory normalization
trajectory.recalled_source_position: Q2 demand recovery expected to remain limited; second-half demand expected to recover gradually as customer inventories decline after adjustments beginning in 2H 2022.
trajectory.product_line_context: DRAM Q1 bit growth missed prior guidance while NAND bit growth exceeded prior guidance; second-half DRAM and NAND product responses were described separately.

trajectory.judgment_scope: memory recovery after customer inventory adjustment
trajectory.recalled_source_position: PC/mobile demand improved with customer inventory adjustments described as completed; both DRAM and NAND ASP increased QoQ, while Samsung stated memory market conditions were expected to recover in 2024 and overall demand to recover gradually as customer inventories normalize.
trajectory.product_line_context: HBM/DDR5/LPDDR5x/UFS were emphasized as high-value products, but broad memory recovery remained qualified by conventional-server weakness and macro uncertainty.

trajectory.judgment_scope: observed market recovery plus forward recovery pace
trajectory.recalled_source_position: Samsung reported market recovery versus the prior quarter, accelerated DRAM/NAND inventory depletion and DRAM profitability, while expecting moderate recovery in 1H 2024 and more significant improvement in 2H.
